title: Regular Term Deposit (Interest Paid at Maturity)

sections.content:
Type: Fixed-term deposit where both the principal and the accrued interest are paid in full at the maturity date. Benefits:
• Guaranteed fixed return throughout the investment period.
• Higher savings discipline as funds remain invested until maturity.
• Suitable for customers saving toward a future financial goal.
• Safe investment with predictable returns. Eligibility Criteria:
• Available to individual customers with a valid account.
• Minimum deposit amount 5000JD or 5000$.
• Funds must remain invested until the maturity date. Fees & Charges:
• No account opening or maintenance fees.
• Early withdrawal before maturity may result in reduced or forfeited interest, according to the bank's terms and conditions. How to Create It:
• Visit any bank branch or apply through the bank's mobile app
• Select the deposit amount and desired investment term.
• Review and accept the terms and conditions. Classified as: CBoJ - Internal
• Fund the deposit from an eligible account.
